name: Link Toolkit
tagline: Render a URL column as a real link, on a form and in a view.
summary:
Installs two controls that render a web address held in a text column as a real link: **LinkField** for a single column on a form, and **LinkColumn** for every row of a view or subgrid.

- Links open through the platform, so a click never navigates the form away from an unsaved edit
- Only `http` and `https` addresses are followable
- An unsaved edit survives a form tab switch

limitations: Opening a link is a platform call, navigation.openUrl, and the demo cannot open anything from inside its sandbox. So Open hands the address to the event log under the demo, which offers it to open in a new tab; on a form the platform opens it.

Keeping an unsaved edit across a form tab switch depends on the platform destroying the control and re-creating it with what mode.setControlState saved. Remount in the demo's toolbar does that: type into the field without leaving it, press Remount, and the draft is still there, with the event log showing the state init() was handed. Whether a real form's tab switch makes the same round trip has not been measured.

This repository ships two controls — LinkField (field) and LinkColumn (dataset) — in one solution. PCFHub publishes one component per repository, so the demo and the API reference below cover LinkField only. Both are installed by the download.

presets.name: A web address
presets.description: An address with Open beside it. The demo cannot open links itself, so Open hands it to the event log under the demo. Turn on Read-only to see it as a link named by its host.

presets.name: A labelled link
presets.description: The same address with a label. While editable, the label names the Open button for a screen reader; turn on Read-only and the link reads as the label instead of the host.

presets.name: Missing https://
presets.description: An address typed without its scheme is not a link: the control says so under the field and offers nothing to open. Only http and https addresses are followed.

presets.name: Empty
presets.description: An empty field shows its placeholder, and there is nothing to open until an address is typed.
